outcome: maternal breastfeeding diseases (breast engorgement, fissures, a-/hypo-galactia, discontinuation of breastfeeding, galactocele, mastitis, candidiasis)
newborn breastfeeding diseases (inadequate suction, neonatal jaundice, pathological weight loss, need for admission to NICU)
cohort: The study included 1065 puerperal women from the University Hospital of Modena.
finding: 50% of puerperal women presented a breastfeeding-related disease, with predicting factors for pathology in breastfeeding identified as early gestational age at birth, high maternal age, high birth rate (parity), and maternal nationality.
